name: Kinde

evidence.hosted: F02: hosted cloud SaaS for accounts, authentication and authorization; F35: self-host not applicable

line: Hosted authentication, authorization and billing for SaaS applications.

cells.sso: Free and Pro: 1 connection; Plus and up: unlimited

mau.math: The Free plan covers 1,000 users, so it costs nothing.
The Free plan covers 10,000 users, so it costs nothing.
The Pro plan is $25, plus $0.0175 for each of the 39,500 users above the included amount. That totals $716.25 a month.
The Plus plan is $75, plus $0.0163 for each of the 89,500 users above the included amount. That totals $1,533.85 a month.
